title: Finite-Degree Quantum LDPC Codes Reaching the Gilbert-Varshamov Bound
summary: We construct asymptotically good nested Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) code pairs from Hsu-Anastasopoulos codes and MacKay-Neal codes. For fixed balanced triples with even component degrees and $j_Z\ge4$, we prove that the coding rate stays bounded away from zero and that the relative distances on both sides stay bounded away from zero with probability tending to one as the blocklength grows.
